legend: The organizers of the programming championship have printed the problem statements in several university offices. The university janitor must collect the statements and bring them to the staircase.
A staircase is at one end of a straight corridor with $$$n$$$ offices. Office $$$i$$$ is located $$$i$$$ meters along the corridor from the staircase and contains $$$a_i$$$ printed statements.

You need to move all the statements to the staircase using a cart that can carry at most $$$c$$$ statements at a time. Each trip starts at the staircase with an empty cart and ends at the staircase, where all collected statements are unloaded.
During a trip, you may collect statements from several offices. Statements from the same office may be transported on different trips.
Find the minimum total distance traveled by the cart.
input: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$c$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 200\,000$$$, $$$1 \le c \le 10^9$$$): the number of offices and the capacity of the cart.
The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le 10^6$$$): the numbers of statements in the offices.
output: Print one integer: the minimum total distance, in meters, needed to move all the statements to the staircase.
note: In the first example, one trip collects two statements from office $$$3$$$ and one from office $$$1$$$. Its length is $$$6$$$ meters. Another trip collects the remaining statement from office $$$1$$$ and has length $$$2$$$ meters. The total distance is $$$8$$$ meters.
In the second example, office $$$2$$$ has five statements. Three trips of length $$$4$$$ meters each are needed, so the answer is $$$12$$$.
In the third example, there are no statements, so no trips are needed.

legend.ai: 程序设计锦标赛的组织者将题面打印在了大学的几个办公室里。大学的清洁工必须收集这些题面，并将它们带到楼梯处。
楼梯位于一条有 $$$n$$$ 间办公室的笔直走廊的一端。办公室 $$$i$$$ 距离楼梯沿走廊 $$$i$$$ 米，里面有 $$$a_i$$$ 份打印的声明。
你需要使用一辆一次最多能运载 $$$c$$$ 条陈述的推车，将所有陈述运到楼梯处。每次运输都从楼梯处开始，此时推车为空，并在楼梯处结束，在那里卸下所有收集到的陈述。
在一次旅行中，你可以从多个办公室收集声明。同一办公室的声明可以在不同的旅行中被运送。
求小车行驶的最小总距离。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$c$$$($$$1 \le n \le 200\,000$$$、$$$1 \le c \le 10^9$$$)：办公室的数量和推车的容量。
第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n$$$($$$0 \le a_i \le 10^6$$$)：各办公室中的语句数量。

output.ai: 输出一个整数：将所有陈述移动到楼梯所需的最小总距离（单位：米）。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，一次行程从办公室 $$$3$$$ 收集两份陈述，并从办公室 $$$1$$$ 收集一份。其长度为 $$$6$$$ 米。另一次行程从办公室 $$$1$$$ 收集剩余的一份陈述，长度为 $$$2$$$ 米。总距离为 $$$8$$$ 米。
在第二个示例中，办公室 $$$2$$$ 有五条语句。需要进行三次长度均为 $$$4$$$ 米的行程，因此答案是 $$$12$$$。
在第三个示例中，没有任何陈述，因此不需要进行任何行程。
